        runAsNonRoot: true
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:

                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: redis-cluster
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname

        - name: redis

          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["/conf/update-node.sh", "redis-server", "/conf/redis.conf"]
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP

              containerPort: 6379
            - name: gossip
              containerPort: 16379

            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1000m"
              memory: "1Gi"

            tcpSocket:
              port: client
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 5
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:

                - -c

    - metadata:
